questions.question: Run the full appropriation of the R300 000 profit and close both current accounts.
questions.expected_answer: In the agreement's order: salaries Lerato 108 000 and Karabo 84 000 (192 000); interest on capital at 10% — Lerato 24 000 on 240 000, Karabo 16 000 on 160 000 (40 000); bonus to Karabo 8 000; remainder 300 000 − 240 000 = 60 000, shared 3 : 2 as 36 000 and 24 000. Totals: Lerato 168 000, Karabo 132 000, together exactly 300 000 — the account empties, proving the division. Current accounts: Lerato 6 000 credit + 168 000 − drawings 144 000 = 30 000 credit; Karabo 9 000 debit + 132 000 − 105 000 = 18 000 credit. Salaries and interest are appropriations, never expenses.

questions.question: Process the equipment disposal in four steps and prove the statement of financial position balances.
questions.expected_answer: Disposal: (1) transfer cost 90 000 out of Equipment to Asset Disposal; (2) transfer accumulated depreciation 60 000 to Asset Disposal, leaving carrying value 30 000; (3) record proceeds 36 000; (4) difference 6 000 is a profit on disposal — other income. Statement of financial position: non-current assets 420 000 + current assets 240 000 (stock 120 000, debtors 80 000, bank 40 000) = 660 000, financed by partners' equity 448 000 (capitals 400 000 + current accounts 30 000 and 18 000), loan 112 000, and current liabilities 100 000 = 660 000. The notes reconcile the fixed assets and give each partner's capital and current account column.

questions.question: Compute the year's indicators and comment as three different readers would.
questions.expected_answer: Gross profit 400 000/1 200 000 = 33,3% on sales and 50% on cost, matching policy. Net profit 300 000/1 200 000 = 25%. Stock turnover 800 000/100 000 = 8 times; debtors collection 80 000/480 000 × 12 = 2 months — slack against 30-day terms, tighten collections. Creditor's view: current ratio 240 000/100 000 = 2,4 : 1 and acid test 120 000/100 000 = 1,2 : 1 — liquid, safe. Lender's view: debt-equity 112 000/448 000 = 0,25 : 1 — lightly geared, capacity to borrow. Partners' view: return on average equity 300 000/422 500 ≈ 71%, far above bank rates, remembering the partners' salaries sit inside that return. Every comment: figure, comparison, judgement.
